{{Quote|I'll try to get back to you one way or the other; but if you haven't heard from me in about twenty-eight hours, don't expect to.''"<br />"''All right. I suppose it's better than nothing. You can leave any messages with the night bartender at the Dona Laza tapcafe.|[[Aves]] and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
This '''unidentified planet''' was located in the [[Dona Laza sector/Legends|Dona Laza sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]],<ref name="Planetnamia" /><ref name="EAOC" /> at a distance of approximately twenty-eight [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel away from [[Tangrene]].<ref name="TLC5" /> It hosted the [[Dona Laza]] [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] and the [[Mumbri Storve]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="TLC" />

==History==
===Thrawn campaign===
{{Quote|If we leave now, we should get to Tangrene just about on time for the big battle.''"<br />"''Let's just hope he's planning to sell that information to the Empire. It'd be a shame to have wasted the whole evening.''"<br />"''He'll sell all right. He's a smuggler. What else could he want it for?|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] and [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]]|<ref name="TLC5" />}}
[[File:Mumbri_Storve.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] at the [[Mumbri Storve]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]]]
During the [[Thrawn campaign]] of [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the [[New Republic pilot/Legends|New Republic pilots]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] and [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] went to this [[Planet/Legends|planet]] just prior to the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]]. They spent an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] at the [[Mumbri Storve]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in an attempt to drop a hint that the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] would be attacking [[Tangrene]] instead of [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi]]. They were successful at first, as they were being followed by a [[Unidentified Aqualish Imperial spy|Walrus-faced]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. However, they were intercepted on their way out by [[Aves]], a member of [[Talon Karrde]]'s [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Car'das/Legends|organization]]. Aves and two of his men then neutralized the [[Mercenary/Legends|freelance]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] spy by knocking him unconscious.<ref name="TLC" />

[[File:Unidentified_planet_Dona_Laza_skyline.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]], [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Aves]] on the planet]]
Aves assured Antilles that the Aqualish freelancer would not be making any reports anytime soon for the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. As a result, their [[Local day/Legends|evening]] spent spreading disinformation seemed entirely wasted. In order to accomplish their objective anyway, Antilles dropped Aves a hint that the New Republic would be attacking Tangrene in twenty-eight hours, in the possibility that the smuggler would sell the information to the Empire. The [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and the group of smugglers then parted ways, with Aves telling Antilles that any messages left with the night [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] at the [[Dona Laza]] [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] would reach him.<ref name="TLC" />

Following the encounter, Aves and his men left the scene aboard a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]], taking with them the still-unconscious Aqualish spy.<ref name="TLC5" />

===Caamas Document Crisis===
{{Quote|Popular place tonight.''"<br />"''It's their turn at the floating Boga Minawk tournament. You wouldn't believe how crazy they go for the game around here.|[[Shada D'ukal]] and [[Mazzic]]|<ref name="SofP" />}}
During the [[Caamas Document Crisis]] of [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the smuggler [[Mazzic]], along with [[Shada D'ukal]], [[Griv]] and [[Cromf]], went to the Dona Laza tapcafe in order to catch [[Lak Jit]], an [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] who was selling information on a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] involvement in the [[Caamas Firestorm|destruction]] of [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]].<ref name="SofP" />

At the [[Time/Legends|time]], the establishment was frequented by a large number of [[Boga Minawk]] enthusiasts.<ref name="SofP" />
